subject: dcat multivariate parameters cannot be expressions

messages.author: 63cc02caac0434cf
messages.subject: dcat multivariate parameters cannot be expressions
parts:
Hello,

I am a student new to nimble trying to fit a basic markov switching model on the lamb data set. I tried the following code. 

library(nimble)
library(label.switching)

data("fetal-lamb")

T <- length(lamb)

lambConsts <- list(T=T)

lambData <- list(y=lamb)

lambInits <- list("ep"=matrix(c(.5,.5,.5,.5),2,2),
                  "S"=sample(c(1,2),size = 240,prob=c(.5,.5),replace=TRUE),
                  "u"=c(mean(lamb),mean(lamb)),
                  "S0"=sample(c(1,2),size = 1,prob=c(.5,.5),replace=TRUE))

lambCode <- nimbleCode({

  ## Specify data likelihood
  for(t in 1:T){
    y[t] ~ dpois(u[S[t]])
  }
  #Specify markov chain
  S0 ~ dcat(c(.5,.5))
  S[1] ~ dcat(c(ep[S0,1],ep[S0,2]))
  for(t in 2:T){
  S[t] ~ dcat(c(ep[S[t-1],1],ep[S[t-1],2]))
  }
  ## Specify priors
  ep[1,1] ~ dbeta(1,1)
  ep[1,2] <- 1-ep[1,1]
  ep[2,2] ~ dbeta(1,1) 
  ep[2,1] <- 1-ep[2,2]
  u[1] ~ dgamma(1,.5)
  u[2] ~ dgamma(1,.5)
  
})


lamb <- nimbleModel(code = lambCode, name = "lamb", constants = lambConsts,
                    data = lambData, inits = lambInits)

But it gave me the error "Error with parameter 'prob' of distribution 'dcat': multivariate parameters cannot be expressions; please define the expression as a separate deterministic variable and use that variable as the parameter." I looked in the group and you have to provide dcat with deterministic expressions so I tried,

lambCode <- nimbleCode({
  
  ## Specify data likelihood
  for(t in 1:T){
    y[t] ~ dpois(u[S[t]])
  }
  #Specify markov chain
  S0 ~ dcat(c(.5,.5))
  p[1,1] <- ep[S0,1]
  p[1,2] <- ep[S0,2]
  S[1] ~ dcat(p[1,1:2])
  for(t in 2:T){
    p[t,1] <- ep[S[t-1],1]
    p[t,2] <- ep[S[t-1],2] 
    S[t] ~ dcat(p[t,1:2])
  }
  ## Specify priors
  ep[1,1] ~ dbeta(1,1)
  ep[1,2] <- 1-ep[1,1]
  ep[2,2] ~ dbeta(1,1) 
  ep[2,1] <- 1-ep[2,2]
  u[1] ~ dgamma(1,.5)
  u[2] ~ dgamma(1,.5)
  
})

But I get the same error. My code should be reproducible. Help would be very much appreciated. 

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: dcat multivariate parameters cannot be expressions
parts:
Hi Dirk,

Can you please try lifting the c(.5,.5) out of the dcat expression, like

S0probs[1:2] <- c(0.5, 0.5)
S0 ~ dcat(S0probs[1:2])

and let us know if that works?

Perry
